idea-plugin.name: api — OpenAPI Converter
idea-plugin.description:
Convert OpenAPI 3.x JSON/YAML specs into API client collections and HTML documentation previews via the `api` CLI.
Provides actions to convert the current spec (or a picked file) into Postman, Bruno, Insomnia, Hoppscotch, REST Client, Thunder Client, Yaak, Hurl, Kreya or curl collections under `api-collections/`, and to generate browsable docs (Swagger UI, ReDoc, Scalar, Stoplight Elements, RapiDoc) under `api-docs/` — next to the spec file.
Requires the `api` CLI on PATH (configurable in Settings → Tools → api).

action.description: Convert an OpenAPI spec into API client collections
Generate browsable HTML API docs from an OpenAPI spec
Show the API client formats supported by the api CLI
